about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: National Directory Platform for Environmental & AMDAL Experts in Indonesia
about.vision_text: To become a trusted platform connecting environmental experts with sustainable development projects in Indonesia.
about.mission_1: Provide a complete directory of verified environmental experts
about.mission_2: Facilitate access to information and collaboration among environmental practitioners
about.mission_3: Support transparency and professionalism in environmental consultation
about.mission_4: Build a professional ecosystem in AMDAL and environmental fields
about.desc1: AMDAL.ID is a platform for searching experts or specialists to compile AMDAL as well as resource persons in Indonesia who have certificates. This platform aims to make it easier to find AMDAL compilers according to their respective expertise and expertise.
about.desc2: AMDAL also serves as a medium for obtaining information about regulations, articles, training institutions and AMDAL compilers.
